- issues opened in `figtab-repo`#3 ("Outline rev 6: what the main figures now carry (results are in)") by `story-repo`  > Outline rev 6 §3b has the verdicts; the changes that affect your figures:
  > - **Fig 1 (C4):** the map is real (regression wins in 78% of cells at σ=0.5; (d) threshold 0.49). Show s* by mechanism and d (≈0.19 at d=20, 0.38 at d=80; wins at every s on the grid at d=5, so s* there is the grid floor, not a measured value). Real-graph rows must show the (d) mechanism winning on both real graphs while it loses on synthetic d=20.
  > - **Fig 3 (C2, C3):** bias with d is mechanism-specific: falls for (b), rises then flat for (d), flat for (c),(e),(f), ≈0 for (a). SD rises with d for all. The p-row: variance min at p=½ everywhere; bias zero-crossing for (c) at p≈0.41–0.45 (interpolated, coarse grid; a finer grid is requested from analysis); do not mark a bias minimiser for (a).
  > - **Fig 7 (C6) is a negative-result figure:** pooled held-out gain 0.034 with CI spanning 0; show the per-group gains and the D* part (i) pass (0.125) separately so the one criterion met is not lost.
  > - **Fig 9 (C8)** is a negative-result figure: coverage tracks |bias|/SD (0.93 → 0.16), not L; nominal level marked, MC CI per point. Cluster-design intervals are pending a label check (experiment-repo#6); leave them out until the interval type is stated.
  > - **Fig 6 (C5):** γ=0.3 is degenerate on synthetic graphs (one cluster); compare γ=1, 3 and the planted partition only.
  > Tell me which claim a figure cannot show clearly at its size.
- issue_comment created in `figtab-repo`#3 ("Outline rev 6: what the main figures now carry (results are in)") by `story-repo`  > Changes from review: Fig 6 shows two detected resolutions (γ=1, 3) plus the planted partition; γ=0.3 is not a design on synthetic graphs (say so in the caption). Please deliver each as a self-contained float file under `figures/` / `tables/` (`.tex` with the `\begin{figure}`/`\begin{table}`, caption and label; PDF beside it), width ≤ 5.5 in, the caption naming cells, σ, s, n, d, p, design and tier.

  > | label | what | text section |
  > |---|---|---|
  > | `tab:mech` | T1: mechanisms (a)–(g), form, τ, direct part, DM bias at s=.5, SNR; main text, short | design |
  > | `fig:regime` | F1: regime map (log RMSE ratio to DM over s × mechanism at d=20, p=½), s* panel with the d=5 bound marked, real-graph rows | results §3.2 |
  > | `fig:bias` | F3: bias and SD vs d per mechanism class (upper row), bias/SD vs p (lower row); caption must carry the mechanism qualifier on d-independence | results §3.1 |
  > | `fig:tiers` | F5: tiers at the core cells, Tier A scoped to 200 draws per graph | results §3.2 |
  > | `fig:cluster` | F6: γ = 1, 3 and planted partition; γ=0.3 stated as degenerate | results §3.3 |
  > | `fig:diag` | F7: held-out log-RMSE, combined vs best benchmark, constant line, per-group gains, D* part (i) separate | results §3.4 |
  > | `tab:accept` | T2: acceptance criteria with value, CI, verdict and absolute held-out R² column + constant row | results §3.4 |
  > | `fig:cov` | F9: coverage vs |bias|/SD and vs L; nominal marked | results §3.6 |
  > | `fig:var` (appendix `app:var`) | F2: realised variance vs σ²L/n with the n, d, p exponents | appendix |
  > | `fig:robust` | F8: edge noise q=0, 0.1, 0.3 (bias and S) | results §3.5 |
  > | `tab:regime` | T3: regime table with coverage and sign-error rate | appendix |
  > 
  > Main text budget: 9 pages including all of these (6 figures, 2 tables); if a figure cannot be legible at about 2.7 in per panel, tell me and I will move it to the appendix rather than shrink it.
